# Visual AI

> Visual AI (https://visual-ai.app) is a web AI image studio. Sign in, spend credits, and generate or edit still images. It is not visualai.app.

Visual AI is for people who need still images without a subscription: designers, marketers, photographers restoring prints, and anyone turning a prompt into a picture. There is no video product.

## What you can do

- Text to image (FLUX family, including FLUX Pro and FLUX Max, plus other still-image models): https://visual-ai.app/text-to-image → studio https://visual-ai.app/create
- Image upscaler: https://visual-ai.app/image-upscaler → https://visual-ai.app/create/upscale
- Colorize photo: https://visual-ai.app/colorize-photo → https://visual-ai.app/create/colorize
- Photo restorer: https://visual-ai.app/photo-restorer → https://visual-ai.app/create/revive
- Remove background: https://visual-ai.app/remove-background → https://visual-ai.app/create/remove_bg

## Public pages

## Credits (the only economy)

You buy credits. There are no paid subscription tiers.

- New account: 50 persistent credits (they do not expire).
- Every day: 30 daily credits. Unused daily credits reset (use-or-lose).
- Purchased credits persist and never expire.
- Pay in INR via Razorpay. Packs and current prices: https://visual-ai.app/pricing

Typical spend (exact cost is shown in the studio before you run):

- Budget / standard generation: 1 credit
- Premium generation (e.g. FLUX Pro/Max): 4–5 credits
- Utility (upscale, colorize, restore, remove background): 2 credits
- Premium upscalers: 4 credits

## Ownership

You own the images you generate. Commercial use is allowed.

Do not invent user counts, quality scores, or speed claims that are not stated here.
